title.narrative: WFP Support to European Union-Caribbean-Resilient programme (EU-CA-RES)

description.narrative: Contract related to: WFP Support to European Union-Caribbean-Resilient programme (EU-CA-RES) - The multiple dimensions of vulnerability of the Caribbean have been exacerbated over the last years, triggered primarily by the combination of four major humanitarian and development challenges at once: (i) the COVID-19 pandemic; (ii) increased migration due to political and governance crises coupled with economic crises (Haiti, Cuba and the Venezuelan forced migration and refugee crisis) (iii) the regular Atlantic hurricane seasons, and (iv) a wide range of recurrent natural hazards (floods, droughts, volcanic eruptions, earthquakes,) posing intensified and new sources of volatility through impacts on land and marine ecosystems, health, food security and livelihoods, infrastructure and coastal landscapes. In this context, the overall objective of the INTPA-EU intervention is to strengthen resilience to the impacts of climate change by 1/increasing coverage and adequacy of inclusive shock responsive and gender inclusive social protection schemes, as well as 2/ accelerating the recovery capacities. Mobilizing sustainable investments from the Private Sector to reduce risks and build-back-better in critical infrastructure and enhance resilience will be mainstreamed across both pillars. The programme will contribute to:1. More coverage and Adequacy of Shock Responsive Social Protection Mechanisms·      Institutionalization of Shock Responsive Social Protection at national and regional level·      Strengthen planning, design and implementation of cash-based assistance to respond to shocks and support most vulnerable and affected households ·      Developing and strengthening social protection delivery systems (delivery of cash, care and services support to respond to large scale shocks), including digital options for enhanced and more accountable programme operation ·      Development of strategies for shock responsive social protection financing2. Accelerating Recovery Capacities·Strengthened policy, institutions, governance for recovery ·Promote Financial Mechanisms for Recovery and Private sector engagement on both Recovery and Multi Hazards Early Warning Systems sustainability. ·Support the review and update of preparedness plans for multi -dimensional risks·Guidelines for Recovery that Improves recovery implementation. ·Training of communities in recovery and disaster resilient construction technologies and supporting the construction of resilient and green community-based infrastructure Importantly, by providing training and supporting construction of resilient, climate-proof infrastructure, the project enhances absorptive capacity, enabling communities to better withstand and recover from the impacts of external shocks. Moreover, by enhancing social protection programs and systems, the project provides a safety net for vulnerable populations, enabling them to better cope with and recover from external shocks and enhancing their adaptive capacities. Involvement of the private sector in delivering basic services will also contribute to this.
